description: Proposed Road Closures - Queensland is a dataset listed in Peclet Queensland open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Natural Resources and Mines, Manufacturing and Regional and Rural Development. Applications for temporary or permanent road closure under the Land Act 1994 in Queensland are made to the Department of Resources. The department publishes the current list of proposed road closures every week. Coverage: Queensland. The portal files it under Transport, Movements. Its keywords are roads, road closures. The portal shows 9 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-queensland-portal.
